name: @narduk-enterprises/narduk-charts
description: NardukCharts — Vue 3 SVG charting for dashboards and trading-grade market UIs (TypeScript, themable, accessible). Package: @narduk-enterprises/narduk-charts.

scripts.build: export NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:+$NODE_OPTIONS }--max-old-space-size=${NARDUK_BUILD_MAX_OLD_SPACE_SIZE:-4096}"; vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build && NC_ENTRY=line vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=bar vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=pie vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=candle vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=studies vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && cp dist/index.d.ts dist/index.d.cts && rm -f dist/entry-*.css
scripts.build:only: vite build && NC_ENTRY=line vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=bar vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=pie vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=candle vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=studies vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && cp dist/index.d.ts dist/index.d.cts

//overrides: Security-only pins for transitive advisories (narduk-charts#15, recurrence closed by narduk-charts#35). Each stays INSIDE its dependent's declared major so no consumer range is broken, with one deliberate exception: brace-expansion 5.x is dual ESM/CJS and still satisfies minimatch's require() (bumped 5.0.8 -> 5.0.9, GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895); fast-uri stays on 3.x for ajv (bumped 3.1.4 -> 3.1.7, GHSA-7p8r-x3mc-p8w7 and siblings); nanoid stays on 3.x for postcss (added 3.3.18, GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8); postcss stays on 8.x for vite/tailwind. js-yaml is the exception: GHSA-5p4m-2wfm-xmqj's fix was never backported to the 3.x/4.x line gray-matter (a histoire dev-only transitive dep) declares, so it is pinned to 5.4.1 across the major -- safe because no CI or build script invokes histoire/gray-matter's YAML parsing path, only local `story:dev`/`story:build`. Drop an entry once every dependent resolves a fixed version on its own.
author: narduk
